headline: Danske Bank Accounts Linked to Historical Trump Payments
summary: Berlingske reported that accounts at Danske Bank's former Estonian branch transferred money to Donald Trump prior to the branch being closed over extensive money laundering and financial crime revelations.
why: Danske Bank's Estonian branch was at the center of one of Europe's largest money laundering scandals, involving more than 200 billion euros in suspicious non-resident funds.

impacts.name: Danske Bank
impacts.why: Fresh media reports detailing historical illicit transfers resurrect legacy compliance and reputational concerns.
